## Personality

Fred Wright is described as a very nice and jolly individual. Despite these pleasant traits, he is viewed as unremarkable by those around him.

## History

Fred Wright became involved with the local community in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and spent time with [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). He eventually professed his love for [Diana](../character/diana.md) in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden, a declaration she returned. Following this mutual confession, Fred and [Diana](../character/diana.md) became engaged, which [Diana](../character/diana.md) then shared with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), +139 more_

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di--fred-wright.md)

Fred is romantically involved with [Di](../character/di.md) and began courting her during the events of Volume 2.

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fred-wright.md)

Fred and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a deep romantic bond that culminates in their engagement. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbles upon the two of them professing their love for one another in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to share the news of their betrothal.

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) act as comrades and partners in canvassing local community members. Their shared work focuses on supporting the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and its various initiatives.

- Comrade of — canvassing partners  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048)</sub>
